entities.summary: Gogland or Hogland is a Russian island in the Gulf of Finland in the eastern Baltic Sea, about 180 kilometres (110 mi) west from Saint Petersburg and 35 kilometres (22 mi) from the coast of Finland. The current population of the island is very low. It belongs to Russia's Kingiseppsky District in the Leningrad Oblast.
